U2 TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1: VS(8)→+12V, FAULT(3)→TP3, OUT(7)→J7, GND(6)→GND, DIAG_EN(2)/IN(1)→NET0017, DELAY(5)→NC, EP(9)→GND — no pin 4/CL shown

The board's heater protection behaves differently from the reference design.
